items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: I heard Bunk in New Orleans too. I heard Bunk here on Parades. I heard Bunk at Banquets.

ctx.x: Okay, it's going again. You were talking about Isidore Fritz and different people.

Yeah, I heard because Bunk was supposed to be instructing that band, Isidore Fritz, the old man Fritz, and Loya Fritz, and little Caggley who plays trumpet. B's brother, Kleyber, was playing the drum all this way with Tommy Ladner.
They all came from across the lake today and lived over there.
